title: Warm Sweet Tunisian Dulce De Leche Tagine
description: A rich and creamy Tunisian dessert featuring dulce de leche and Mediterranean flavors, perfect for satisfying midnight cravings. This jammy and pillowy treat is sure to become a favorite.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large saucepan, combine dulce de leche, butter, and heavy cream, and cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until the mixture is smooth and warm.
Remove the saucepan from the heat and stir in orange blossom water and rose water, if using.
Let the mixture cool slightly, then stir in pistachios, sea salt, and vanilla extract.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish and bake for 20 minutes, or until the top is lightly golden.
Remove the tagine from the oven and let it cool for 10 minutes before serving.
Serve the tagine warm, garnished with additional pistachios and a sprinkle of sea salt, if desired.
Refrigerate any leftovers and reheat them in the microwave or oven when desired.
